name: Spielberg
source: public: open-data centreline and widths (GIS-Steiermark Orthofoto 2022-24 white lines, tools/track/centreline_fit.py); road height and banking fitted to GIS-Steiermark ALS DGM 1 m (Gelaendehoehe Gesamtmodell) (CC BY 4.0 AT); fixed track frame (tracks/spielberg/georef.json)
attribution: Centreline and widths: fitted to the white edge lines in Land Steiermark - GIS-Steiermark, Orthofotos Befliegung 2022-2024 (CC BY 4.0 AT), tools/track/centreline_fit.py
Search seed: (c) OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL), highway=raceway ways (tools/track/osm_seed.py); no OSM geometry is output
Track frame: fixed transform to EPSG:32633 (tracks/spielberg/georef.json)
Elevation: Land Steiermark - data.steiermark.gv.at (ALS Gelaendehoehe 1 m, CC BY 4.0) (CC BY 4.0 AT)
Kerbs: detected in Land Steiermark - GIS-Steiermark, Orthofotos Befliegung 2022-2024 (20 cm, CC BY 4.0 AT)
types_note: grip values and the type rule are PLACEHOLDERS (docs/models/road-surface.md §5)

provenance.grid: 8619 rows x 140 nodes, ds = 0.500013 m, dn = 0.25 m, >= 10.0 m beyond each white line
provenance.kerbs: tracks/spielberg/kerbs.json: kerbs detected in the open orthophoto (open orthophoto only (CC BY 4.0); docs/models/kerb-detection.md); the regularised kerbs (regular_bands: bridged, smoothed width, height taper at the ends) placed from our white line outward, width clipped to [0.3, 3.0] m; profile ASSUMPTION: linear rise to 0.05 m at the outer edge (lower when narrower than 1.0 m), 0.2 m outer ramp; painted run-off areas and the paved extent seen in the photo (paved_d_1m) typed RunoffAsphalt; kerb types from tracks/spielberg/kerb_types.json (flat / ridged / sausage / paint, docs/models/kerb-types.md): sausage and paint profiles in the grid, ridges analytic in the core from the header's kerb records
provenance.types: asphalt inside the white lines; kerb band; run-off asphalt 3.0 m (and painted run-off); then the site's ground classes (tracks/spielberg/ground.png, nearest 0.5 m pixel): gravel -> Gravel, paved and paint -> RunoffAsphalt, else Grass

registration.equation: [E, N] = scale * R(theta) [x, y] + [tx, ty]; (x, y) = TrackProfile / surface frame (m)
registration.method: robust rigid fit (Huber 0.3 m, trim 2.5 m, point-to-line, 4 re-detections) of our white lines onto the white edge lines detected in the open orthophoto (tools/track/registration.py; docs/models/terrain.md 2.1); scale locked to 1; start: the OSM fit
registration.source: Land Steiermark - GIS-Steiermark, Orthofotos Befliegung 2022-2024 (20 cm), CC BY 4.0 AT
registration.osm: start transform only: (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL
registration.rms_note: rms_m: Huber-weighted rms of the edge detections after the fit; clean centre offset rms 1.425 m = the non-rigid residual (TUM centreline shape), see residual_stretches

start.method: trimmed ICP (8 m) of the centreline every 2 m onto OSM highway=raceway ways densified to 1 m (point-to-line steps); scale locked to 1

scale_test.note: free scale of the local -> CRS map on the final detections (1 sigma from the weighted LS, optimistic: detection errors are correlated along s); expected = UTM point scale x R/(R+h), h ~ 730 m ellipsoidal

residual_stretches.note: [s0, s1, mean, max |.|] per run; _clean: metres whose width difference is within CLEAN_WIDTH_M of the lap median (both lines the road's own)

road_structures.method: road centre height and bank replaced inside each zone by a cubic Hermite tied to the road on both sides (line fit over 15.0 m outside each end); docs/models/road-surface.md 6.4

ground.source: Land Steiermark - GIS-Steiermark, Orthofotos Befliegung 2022-2024 (20 cm), CC BY 4.0 AT; LiDAR: public: GIS-Steiermark ALS DGM 1 m (Gelaendehoehe Gesamtmodell)
ground.rule: nodes beyond the paved strip: gravel -> Gravel, paved / paint -> RunoffAsphalt, else Grass (docs/models/road-surface.md §5)
